scoring_hook.signature: def score_term(tf, df, doc_len, avg_len, N)

arguments.tf: integer count of this query token in this ONE document
arguments.df: integer number of corpus documents containing this token
arguments.doc_len: integer token count of this document

scoring_hook.return: scalar term-frequency component TIMES inverse-document-frequency component; framework sums matching terms
scoring_hook.note: All arguments are numbers, not lists, Counters or arrays. Preserve numeric source defaults.

response.explanation: This function validates input constraints and computes the BM25Plus score by multiplying the term frequency component with the inverse document frequency component using the specified parameters.
